english.note: Use this when acknowledging that someone’s help has put you in their debt and expressing sincere gratitude.

examples.english: You found me a job this time, so I’m truly in your debt; I hope to oblige you in return.
examples.traditional: 今次多得你幫我搵到份工，真係承你情。
